arXiv:2608.28495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying threading dislocations in semiconductor materials via electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) is heavily bottlenecked by slow manual analysis. item.description:

👤 Aaqib Ali, Aslam Faqeer Mohammad
Accurate prediction of punching shear capacity in reinforced concrete (RC) flat slabs remains a challenging task due to the complex interaction between material properties, reinforcement characteristics, and geometric parameters. Conventional design provisions, such as ACI 318 − 19, employ simplified empirical formulations that are easy to implement; however, they may exhibit considerable prediction uncertainty because of the highly non-linear nature of punching shear failure. Moreover, although machine learning (ML) models, such as eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), provide enhanced predictive accuracy, their black-box nature limits their direct adoption in practical structural design.
